verdicts.name: Política de seguridad

evidence.detail: Repo describes itself as an intentionally insecure training app; no security policy document, roles or committee are present.

verdicts.rationale: No ENS security policy artefact in the repository. Only project/community governance docs exist (Agents/CoC/Contributing); no mission, legal-regulatory framework, security roles, committee structure or documentation-management directives are defined.

verdicts.name: Normativa de seguridad

evidence.detail: Only a community code of conduct exists; no security usage normativa or disciplinary measures artefact.

verdicts.rationale: No security normativa defining correct/incorrect use of equipment, services or facilities, nor personnel responsibilities/discipline. CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is community behaviour policy, not an ENS security norm.

verdicts.name: Procedimientos de seguridad

evidence.detail: Contribution rules describe PR workflow; no ENS security procedures are documented.

verdicts.rationale: No security procedures defining routine tasks, responsible parties, anomaly reporting, or information handling (access, storage, copies, labelling, transmission). CONTRIBUTING.md covers code contribution workflow only.

verdicts.name: Proceso de autorización

evidence.detail: Deployment is defined directly by Dockerfile/CI; no authorization-process artefact exists in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No authorization process for facilities, production entry of equipment/applications, communications links, media or third-party services. Repo provides no authorisation records or procedure.

verdicts.name: Análisis de riesgos

evidence.detail: Threat model with declared owner ('Björn Kimminich') and STRIDE diagrams.
Threat model has summary/detail structure; no residual-risk or safeguards section.

verdicts.rationale: A STRIDE threat model exists with owner and data-flow diagrams (assets/threats), which partially addresses asset/threat identification, but there is no formal ENS risk analysis mapping safeguards and residual risks.

verdicts.name: Arquitectura de seguridad

evidence.detail: Data-flow/STRIDE diagrams document the system at a high level only.

verdicts.rationale: Some architecture documentation and network segmentation exist (VPC/subnets/security groups/ALB in Terraform, threat-model data-flow diagrams), but there is no ENS security architecture doc with lines-of-defence, interconnection points or authentication scheme description.

verdicts.name: Adquisición de nuevos componentes

evidence.detail: Automated dependency update configuration for javascript package managers.
Dependencies declared/locked; no acquisition process documentation.

verdicts.rationale: Automated dependency updates and locked dependencies exist, giving some procurement/component control, but no process ties component acquisition to risk-analysis conclusions, security architecture, training or funding.

verdicts.name: Dimensionamiento / gestión de la capacidad

evidence.detail: Compose deploy resources limit memory to 512M.

verdicts.rationale: Resource sizing is defined (ECS task CPU/memory, desired count, compose memory limits, subnet layout), partially covering processing/storage capacity, but no formal capacity-management analysis across personnel/communications/facilities dimensions.

verdicts.name: Componentes certificados

evidence.detail: nginx:1.28.0-alpine upstream image, not a CPSTIC-listed product.
mongo:4.4.29 upstream image, no certification evidence.

verdicts.rationale: No evidence of selecting CCN-CPSTIC-qualified/certified products or Article 19-certified components. The stack uses standard upstream images (nginx/redis/mongo) and npm packages with no certification reference.

verdicts.name: Identificación

evidence.detail: Per-user credentials/password field define unique accounts.

verdicts.rationale: Accounts have unique identifiers (UserModel id/email) and distinct roles (customer/deluxe/accounting/admin), partially satisfying identification, but there is no ENS-grade identity management, account-disable lifecycle or retention period.

verdicts.name: Requisitos de acceso

evidence.detail: app.use(cors()) allows all origins per the 'Allow everything!' comment.
Public /ftp directory listing and file download exposed.

verdicts.rationale: Access-control enforcement is intentionally broken: CORS allows everything, an authorization middleware on product modification is commented out, and directory/file listing is exposed. Access to resources is not reliably restricted to authorised entities.

verdicts.name: Segregación de funciones y tareas

evidence.detail: Only a branch/PR contribution model is documented; no segregation-of-duties evidence.

verdicts.rationale: No evidence of segregation of duties between development/operation or between authorisers/controllers. CONTRIBUTING.md describes a PR/branch workflow only, not personnel segregation.

verdicts.name: Proceso de gestión de derechos de acceso

evidence.detail: PUT/DELETE /api/Users/:id denyAll, yet other endpoints are intentionally unguarded.
Role whitelist exists but access rights are not enforced per least privilege.

verdicts.rationale: Roles exist but least-privilege and periodic access review are not implemented; privilege escalation and broken access control are intentional challenges, and some destructive endpoints deny all while others are deliberately left open.

verdicts.name: Mecanismo de autenticación (usuarios externos)

evidence.detail: Login builds SQL by string concatenation (SQLi / loginAdmin challenge).
Known weak admin credential admin123 is a challenge trigger.
Rate limiting only on /rest/user/reset-password; no login attempt limiting.

verdicts.rationale: External authentication is intentionally weak: login uses string-concatenated SQL, a default weak admin credential (admin123) is a known challenge, and rate limiting is applied only to reset-password, not login (no attempt limiting/lockout).

verdicts.name: Mecanismo de autenticación (usuarios de la organización)

evidence.detail: Password stored via security.hash but weak-password challenge is intentional.
Internal login shares the same weak SQL-concatenated authentication path.

verdicts.rationale: Organisation-user authentication lacks credential lifecycle controls: weak/default passwords are intentional challenges, no rotation policy exists, and lockout/attempt-limiting for internal users is absent.

verdicts.name: Inventario de activos

evidence.detail: npm run sbom generates a CycloneDX SBOM (bom.json).

verdicts.rationale: A CycloneDX SBOM is generated at build time, partially covering a software-component inventory, but there is no complete asset inventory identifying every system element and its responsible owner.

traceability.message: Dockerfile runs as root: the final build stage has no non-root USER instruction.

verdicts.name: Contratación y acuerdos de nivel de servicio

evidence.detail: No contracts/SLA artefacts; repo is the open-source application only.

verdicts.rationale: No SLA or external-provider contract artefacts exist in the repository; nothing evidences characteristics of service, minimum acceptable service or provider responsibility.

verdicts.name: Gestión diaria

evidence.detail: No provider service-measurement or coordination procedure artefact found.

verdicts.rationale: No routine process to measure external-service compliance or maintenance-coordination procedures with providers is present in the repository.

verdicts.name: Protección de la cadena de suministro

evidence.detail: CodeQL security scanning of dependencies/source in CI.

verdicts.rationale: Supply-chain hygiene partially exists (Dependabot, CodeQL, SBOM generation), but there is no analysis of supply-chain incident impact, risk estimation or containment measures.

verdicts.name: Interconexión de sistemas

evidence.detail: HTTPS listener/interconnection exists technically, but no interconnexion authorization or interface documentation is in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No prior-authorization records or explicit interface/security/data documentation for interconnections with other systems are present. IaC shows network endpoints but not interconnection agreements.

verdicts.name: Protección de servicios en la nube

evidence.detail: AWS provider used for cloud deployment (ECS/EFS/ALB).
Region eu-west-1; no cloud-conformity or jurisdiction requirements documented.

verdicts.rationale: The system is deployable on AWS (public cloud, IaaS) via Terraform, but there is no evidence of CCN-STIC service-model conformity, pentesting, transparency, key management or data-jurisdiction requirements.

verdicts.name: Análisis de impacto

evidence.detail: No continuity/impact-analysis artefact found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No business-impact analysis artefacts defining service availability requirements or critical elements are present in the repository.

verdicts.name: Plan de continuidad

evidence.detail: No continuity-plan artefact found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No continuity plan (roles, responsibilities, activation of alternative means, training, integration with organisational plans) exists in the repository.

verdicts.name: Pruebas periódicas

evidence.detail: CI/e2e tests periodically run, but these are not continuity-plan tests.

verdicts.rationale: Periodic tests exist for software (CI), but there is no evidence of periodic tests of a continuity plan to detect/correct its deficiencies.

verdicts.name: Medios alternativos

evidence.detail: public_subnet count spans two availability zones.

verdicts.rationale: Technical redundancy exists (2 ECS tasks, two AZ subnets, restart policies, transitive EFS encryption), partially covering alternate means, but there is no planned alternate facilities/personnel/communications or maximum activation time.

verdicts.name: Detección de intrusión

evidence.detail: ALB security group only; no IDS/IPS/WAF resource.
Compose stack (nginx/app/redis/mongo) contains no intrusion-detection service.

verdicts.rationale: No intrusion detection/prevention tools are deployed. Network configuration defines only security groups and an ALB; there is no WAF/IDS/IPS or equivalent detection mechanism.

verdicts.name: Sistema de métricas

evidence.detail: Grafana dashboard with Technical/Business metrics, not ENS compliance metrics.

verdicts.rationale: A Prometheus metrics endpoint and a Grafana dashboard exist, giving partial measurement, but they track application/business metrics, not ENS measure-implantation metrics or the annual report required by art. 32.

verdicts.name: Vigilancia

evidence.detail: morgan('combined') writes access logs to rotating stream.
winston logger outputs to console only.

verdicts.rationale: Automatic event collection partially exists via morgan access logs (daily rotation, audit.json), but there is no SIEM/correlation or security-event surveillance system.

verdicts.name: Áreas separadas y con control de acceso

evidence.detail: Physical facility/area separation is out of scope of the source repository; no artefact present.

verdicts.rationale: No data-centre/CPD facility documentation, separate-area layout or physical access-control evidence exists in the repository.

verdicts.name: Identificación de las personas

evidence.detail: No facility access-registration artefact found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No physical personnel-access identification/registration procedure or entry/exit log for facilities is present.

verdicts.name: Acondicionamiento de los locales

evidence.detail: No facility-conditioning documentation found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No documentation of local environmental conditioning (temperature/humidity, cabling protection, risk-driven protection) exists in the repository.

verdicts.name: Energía eléctrica

evidence.detail: No electrical-supply documentation found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No electrical-supply or emergency-lighting provisions for the hosting facility are documented in the repository.

verdicts.name: Protección frente a incendios.

evidence.detail: No fire-protection documentation found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No fire-protection provisions for the hosting facility are documented in the repository.

verdicts.name: Protección frente a inundaciones.

evidence.detail: No flood-protection documentation found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No flood/water-damage protection provisions for the hosting facility are documented in the repository.

verdicts.name: Registro de entrada y salida de equipamiento.

evidence.detail: No equipment-movement register found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No register of equipment entry/exit from facilities (with authorising person) exists in the repository.

verdicts.name: Caracterización del puesto de trabajo

evidence.detail: Contributor rules only; no workstation/role security-responsibility definition.

verdicts.rationale: No workstation-characterisation or role security-responsibility definition, nor personnel screening requirements, exist in the repository.

verdicts.name: Deberes y obligaciones

evidence.detail: Community conduct only; no personnel duties/obligations or confidentiality clauses.

verdicts.rationale: No personnel duties/obligations register, disciplinary measures or confidentiality commitments (including post-termination and subcontracted personnel) exist in the repository.

verdicts.name: Concienciación

evidence.detail: No security-awareness/concientisation artefact found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No awareness programme covering good-use norms, social engineering or incident reporting exists in the repository.

verdicts.name: Formación

evidence.detail: No security-training programme artefact found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No regular security training programme (system configuration, incident detection/reaction, information handling) exists in the repository.

verdicts.name: Puesto de trabajo despejado

evidence.detail: No clear-desk policy artefact found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No clear-desk policy or evidence about workstation material control exists in the repository.

verdicts.name: Bloqueo de puesto de trabajo

evidence.detail: Endpoint lock configuration is not represented in the repo.

verdicts.rationale: No evidence of workstation inactivity lock or re-authentication configuration; the repository does not manage endpoint workstations.

verdicts.name: Protección de dispositivos portátiles

evidence.detail: No portable-device management artefact found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No inventory of portable devices, loss-reporting procedure, remote-access minimisation or remote-key restriction evidence exists in the repository.

verdicts.name: Otros dispositivos conectados a la red

evidence.detail: No network-device control/erasure artefact found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No configuration controls for other network-connected devices nor their data-erasure functionality are documented in the repository.

evidence.detail: Application config contains no information-classification or owner metadata.

verdicts.rationale: No information classification levels, USO OFICIAL marking, information-owner assignment or criteria for required security level exist. Configuration and data models treat all information uniformly (no classification field).

verdicts.rationale: No electronic-signature mechanism (per Ley 39/2015 or equivalent) is present in the system or documented in the repository.

verdicts.name: Sellos de tiempo

evidence.detail: No time-stamping artefact found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No qualified electronic time-stamping mechanism or verification-data protection/renovation policy exists in the repository.

verdicts.name: Limpieza de documentos

evidence.detail: No document-cleaning artefact found in repo.

verdicts.rationale: No document-cleaning process to remove hidden fields/metadata/comments from documents offered publicly is present in the repository.
